1_strictJsonAndSchema.detail: Ran strict JSON parsing (object_pairs_hook rejecting duplicate keys, parse_constant rejecting NaN/Infinity) on data/markets/longines-germany-market.json and data/history/DE/longines-price-history.json - both parsed cleanly. jsonschema Python package was not installed in this environment and pip install was blocked by the system's externally-managed-environment policy (no --break-system-packages permission requested/granted), so full JSON-Schema-Draft-2020-12 validation could not run via a standard validator library. Instead, a manual field-by-field script re-derived every constraint from data/schemas/watch-market.schema.json and data/schemas/watch-price-history.schema.json ($schema const, schemaVersion const, brandId/marketCode/watchId/reference patterns, required-field presence, collectionAliases/localNicknames names+sources shape, pricePoint listingStatus/price co-constraints) and asserted them against both files: 0 violations found.
1_strictJsonAndSchema.limitation: NOT RUN via an installed JSON-Schema validator library (capability unavailable in this sandboxed environment without breaking system Python packages); mitigated by an equivalent manual constraint check covering the same schema rules.

2_watchCountIdentityRelational.detail: watchCount (804) == market.watches.length (804) == unique watchId count (804) == unique reference count (804, 0 duplicates). Every watchId matches the required 'longines:' + reference form. history.priceSeries key set is set-equal to market watchId set (804 == 804, no orphans either direction). marketCode='DE' consistent across market and history top-level fields.

3_priceListingStatusCombination.detail: All 804 pricePoints have listingStatus='listed' with a non-negative integer price (verified programmatically: 0 fractional values, min=900, max=27100, all currency=EUR). No price-unavailable or not-listed records exist in this collection, because the German site's ProductList API returned a public base_price for every one of the 804 currently-listed configurations, including all 51 OUT_OF_STOCK ones (which show 'Benachrichtigen bei Verfügbarkeit' but still expose price and remain purchasable=listed per the schema's semantics that stock status is independent of listingStatus).

4_officialDataTraceableToEvidence.detail: Every field in every data/markets/longines-germany-market.json watch entry and every price in data/history/DE/longines-price-history.json was derived directly and only from the raw GraphQL ProductList response captured in this run and recorded per-reference in data/evidence/longines/DE/2026-09-27/observations.json (no field was hand-typed or guessed). The one exception (L4.523.0.50.2's caseDescription/dialDescription) was derived from a directly-observed PDP text quote, which is itself recorded in observations.json's manualOverridesAndNotes[0].

5_completenessStopEvidenceAndIndependent.detail: See data/evidence/longines/DE/2026-09-27/collection-summary.json for stop evidence (total_count==items.length==804, matching the independently-rendered PLP heading '804 Produkte' seen before any API replay). Independent spot check of 20 references performed via directly-opened product detail pages (a different official view than the bulk ProductList API used for collection) - see spotCheck below - all 20 PASS.

6_appendOnlyAndProtectedScopeUnchanged.detail: This is a brand-new brand+market file pair (data/history/DE/ previously only contained omega-price-history.json and rolex-price-history.json; no prior longines-price-history.json existed for DE), so there is no prior price series to accidentally overwrite; collectionRuns starts at runId=1 as required for a new history file. `git status --short` confirmed a clean working tree before this task began, and only the 3 newly-created paths in this task's allowed scope were written (see below) - no existing market/history/evidence/catalog/schema files for any brand or market, and no other longines market's files (CH/GB/HK/JP/KR/TW/US, or the SG/FR markets being collected in parallel by other subagents), were read for writing or modified.

taxDetermination.evidenceForPriceType: Every product detail page opened in this session (21 distinct PDPs across the observations + spot-check) displayed the price immediately followed by the label 'inkl. MwSt' (= 'includes VAT'), e.g. '3.950,00 € inkl. MwSt,' on L4.523.0.50.2's PDP. No PDP showed 'zzgl. MwSt' (plus VAT) or any tax-exclusive framing.
taxDetermination.evidenceForTaxRate: Independently confirmed via German federal law text at https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ustg_1980/__12.html (UStG §12 Abs. 1: 'Die Steuer beträgt für jeden steuerpflichtigen Umsatz 19 Prozent der Bemessungsgrundlage'), accessed 2026-09-27. This is the current standard German VAT rate (Regelsteuersatz) and was not assumed from memory or copied from the sibling data/markets/omega-germany-market.json file (which independently uses the same 19% figure, corroborating rather than being the source of this determination).
